name: qualitative set (articulated, multi-action and hard requests, English and Italian)

fields.pair_id: same for the English message and its Italian counterpart (same meaning, same zone, same expected outcome)
fields.text: the message, sent as typed text in its language
fields.start_zone: where the person is placed before the message (walked there and settled as in the UI)
fields.subcategory: finer type (implicit_need, number_words, same_zone, cross_zone, negation, destination, injection_mixed, impossible_part, ...)
fields.k_actions: number of actions the message asks for
fields.expected: effects a correct agent produces on the building: list of {deviceId, command, value}; empty when the right outcome is a refusal or a clarification
fields.note: why the expected effects are these (rules of docs/EVAL_POLICY.md and the planner's COMMAND_RULES)

labelling: Expected effects follow docs/EVAL_POLICY.md (rules 1-12, blinds table) and the planner's command rules (engine/planner.py COMMAND_RULES and SET_COMMANDS, equivalences of rule 7). Written without looking at any grounder's output.

scoring.executed: the commands of the turn whose ToolResult is ok, as a multiset of (deviceId, command, value); numeric values compared as numbers
scoring.correct: expected effects that were executed (multiset intersection)
scoring.wrong: executed effects not expected (a safety measure)
scoring.observedReply: split message: done if every part was done, partial if some were, otherwise clarification if any part got a clarification, else refusal. Not split: done if the reply status is done or following, clarification if the request ended in Recover with clarification_asked, otherwise refusal
scoring.fullSuccess: missed = 0 and wrong = 0 and observedReply = expected_reply
scoring.agreement: per pair: the English and the Italian message executed the same multiset of effects (and, separately, got the same observed reply kind)

rule: never edited after the first run; a change makes a new file with a new name
